sections.Profile:
The "Spider-Man (Home Edition)" pinball machine, released by Stern in 2016, is based on the popular Marvel superhero. It features two flippers, two ramps, and a four-ball multiball mode, designed for home use. The game was created by George Gomez with software by Dean Grover and Mike Kyzivat, and sound by David Thiel.
